raw_row.description:
Telegraph cucumbers are long and thin, and bursting with freshness. Toss a few slices in your water for an extra-refreshing drink, chop them into salads or dunk them in your favourite dip. Telegraph cucumbers are usually available year-round, but they peak during summer. 
●	In season: January - March
●	Packed with: Water, potassium, fibre and vitamins C and K.
●	Cook options: Best enjoyed raw or pickled. 
●	Prep process: Just give it a good wash - the skin’s edible!
Meal inspiration: 
●	Cucumber sticks: Quick to chop and serve with a dip like hummus or tzatziki. 
●	Cucumber salad: A crisp, refreshing side that pairs beautifully with your main meal. Easy as!
Storage tips: Keep whole telegraph cucumbers in your fridge to keep them fresh. Once sliced, place them in a sealed container to stop from drying out.
